NOAA-17 AVHRR Channel 3A


Launch Date             Reference            Pre-launch Calibration Coefficients   
06/24/2002              66.9                 0.026498 -1.117031814 0.185753581 -81.09645563
              
Note for users: The NOAA-17 calibration data showed issues connected to its scan motor failure.
                The Noise estimates showed abnormal deterioration beyond specification limits since April 2010.
                AS such AVHRR data from NOAA-17 are considered Orange which means that "operational with
                "degraded performance" from NOAA/SOCC engineering standpoint. The comments provided on the following
                website states that the data are unusable:
                http://www.oso.noaa.gov/poesstatus/spacecraftStatusSummary.asp?spacecraft=17

                The NOAA-17 scan motor stopped since 10/15/2010. The data have been declared unusable.
                As a consequence there would be no monthly calibration updates for NOAA-17 solar channels
                starting the NOAA/NESDIS/STAR update distributed in October 2010.
